## Summary

Describe the change and its purpose.

## Type of change

- [ ] Content update
- [ ] Design or layout change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Build or deployment change
- [ ] Documentation or community-health change

## Validation

- [ ] `hugo --gc --minify` passes
- [ ] Local pages were checked with `hugo server -D`
- [ ] Links and assets were verified
- [ ] Screenshots included for visual changes, when applicable

## Checklist

- [ ] No secrets or private project data are included.
- [ ] The change is limited to the intended scope.
- [ ] README or documentation was updated when needed.
